results.rationale: Consistency: the tower, its lattice geometry, central placement and reflection are preserved; background additions are requested. Instruction: blue-purple gradient, stars, clouds, birds and the correct title/subtitle appear, but the title is at upper right instead of top center and agency details are gibberish. Quality: multiple lines of garbled agency text visibly degrade an otherwise coherent poster.

Consistency: walls, floor, shelves and original top-right plant remain unchanged. Instruction: a different, much larger potted plant is added at the left of the second tier while the original plant remains atop the right shelf; the requested same-tier transfer is not implemented. Quality: shelf geometry, lighting and foliage are coherent and natural without noticeable artifacts.
